on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_glo_power = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_glo_power_cap = constant:zin_glo.power_max }
			set_variable = { global.zin_glo_regen_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_yeldenne_wards = constant:zin_glo.wards_start }
			Y8H = { country_event = { id = zin_glo.1 days = 2 } }
		}
	}
	on_state_control_changed = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { FROM.FROM = { state = 1063 } }
				FROM.FROM = {
					set_variable = { zin_glo_occupied_since = global.num_days }
					if = {
						limit = { is_controlled_by = OWNER }
						clear_variable = zin_glo_occupied_since
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_annex = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { FROM = { original_tag = Y8H } zin_horos_alive = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_glo.63 }
			}
		}
	}
	on_declare_war = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_glo_conqueror } FROM = { NOT = { OR = { original_tag = Y0U original_tag = Y8D is_subject_of = Y0U is_subject_of = Y8D AND = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed OR = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes zin_afrit_rules_here = yes } } } } } }
				set_country_flag = zin_glo_conqueror
			}
		}
	}
}
